description: Six claims for a live demo, in a suggested order. Each comes from the dev or held-out eval set, so its expected label was checked against the product documents beforehand, and 'observed_in_eval' is copied from the committed result files (the model can change over time, so a live run may differ).

claims.demonstrates: A claim the spec sheet states word for word; the cited passage is the exact quote.

observed_in_eval.cited_passage: IPX8: Waterproof-Tested to operate at least 1.1 meters underwater for 30 minutes.

claims.demonstrates: Threshold reasoning: the spec says at least 1.1 meters, which satisfies a claim of 1 meter.
A numeric claim that conflicts with the spec; the cited line shows the real value.

claims.claim: the Nutri Ninja cup holds 32 ounces
claims.demonstrates: A contradiction found in a long PDF manual, not a short spec sheet.

claims.claim: can connect to two devices at the same time
claims.demonstrates: A claim the documentation never mentions: the system says it cannot confirm it and cites nothing, instead of guessing.
A known limitation: the product page says 'Country of Origin: China', but the judge answered unverifiable. It failed in the safe direction (declined to confirm) instead of approving a false claim.
